name: Mending Communications

faq.answer: Sebelia stays at the summit camp on Mount Hyjal, tending to mail and supplies for those stationed high on the mountain.
Innkeeper Vizzie manages the inn down in the goblin town of Everlook, where she sorts and distributes letters from the highlands.
faq.q: Who takes the parcels in Everlook?

aliases: why does hyjal need mail moved
faq.answer: Fighting on the heights and a retreat from Nordrassil Lodge left the camp shorthanded, cutting off normal travel and regular post between the peaks and Winterspring.
faq.q: Why are communications disrupted on Mount Hyjal?

faq.answer: Heavy fighting on the mountain forced defenders to fall back from Nordrassil Lodge, stretching supplies and personnel thin.

sections.body: Fighting across Mount Hyjal and a forced retreat from Nordrassil Lodge have left the defenders shorthanded at the summit camp. Sebelia needs someone traveling down the mountain path to carry a bundle of mail parcels into Everlook, so word from the heights reaches the lowlands.
sections.title: Letters from the Summit

sections.body: At the inn in Everlook, Innkeeper Vizzie receives the mountain dispatch to sort into the town post. Carrying these dispatches keeps the beleaguered camp above tied to Winterspring while defenders hold the heights.
sections.title: Word to Everlook

summary: Sebelia needs mail parcels carried down from the summit camp on Mount Hyjal to Innkeeper Vizzie in Everlook. Heavy fighting and a retreat from Nordrassil Lodge have left the mountain outpost shorthanded, threatening contact with the settlements below.
